exposure: Intelligent pelvic floor rehabilitation model (mobile application use and smart dumbbells)
cohort: A total of 209 elderly female patients with stress urinary incontinence undergoing pelvic floor muscle rehabilitation were selected by convenient sampling.
finding: The intelligent pelvic floor rehabilitation model, combining a mobile application with smart dumbbells, significantly improved pelvic floor muscle strength and quality of life at 12 weeks compared to routine care in elderly patients with urinary incontinence.
